verdict.rationale: Netlify's PR-based deploy previews (docs-1, docs-19, comm-10) give every branch/PR its own isolated environment, and unlimited preview URLs support concurrent team shipping without conflicts. However, evidence doesn't confirm truly 'unlimited' scaling claims or address environment-level isolation for backend/DB resources beyond static/serverless previews, and independent corroboration is limited to older HN comments praising PR previews generically. Missing for 10: explicit unlimited-environment guarantees, isolation of stateful resources (DB branches) per environment, and enterprise-scale team usage evidence.
